jobs.description: Our plant Henri van de Bilt in Beuningen is looking for a Supply Chain Planner (m/f/d).ResponsibilitiesAs a Supply Chain Planner, you are responsible for optimally planning and coordinating materials, production, and inventory. (You ensure that customer orders are delivered on time and in full.) You ensure that products are available on time and that the Supply Chain operates efficiently and reliably.- Ensuring optimal production planning- Coordinating demand forecasts and translating them into concrete planning requirements- Monitoring and managing inventory levels to achieve optimal stock and service performance, in collaboration with inventory management and procurement- Identifying and resolving supply risks, shortages, and disruptions- Collaborating closely with Procurement, Inventory Management, Warehouse, Production, Logistics, and Sales to align planning and execution- Providing Supply Chain KPIs- Supporting continuous improvement initiatives within planning and broader Supply Chain processes.What We Expect- Good communication skills and the ability to effectively manage various stakeholders- Strong planning, organizational, and coordination skills- Strong Excel and data analysis skills- Analytical ability and strong attention to detail- The ability to work in a deadline-driven environment- Proactive, solution-oriented, and flexible work attitude- Experience with ERP systems; knowledge of SAP is an advantage- Strong Excel and data analysis skills- Fluency in Dutch and EnglishWhat We Offer YouWe are a company with flat hierarchies, strong values, and a clear focus on our customers. We know that our employees are the key to our success. That is why we quickly give you responsibility and help you grow according to your talents.We offer:- A responsible and versatile role within Supply Chain & Logistics- A professional work environment with room for initiative and improvement- Opportunities to contribute to process improvements within planning and Supply Chain- A full-time position during regular daytime hours- A role where you collaborate with various departments within the organization

 As part of our current growth, we are looking for an HR assistant for Europe Zone
 

Job Description
 
 

• Work with lead HR Europe, based in France (Paris), to manage all cross countries HR processes and provide operational & administrative support  
 

• Countries: France, UK, Belgium, Netherlands, Sweden 

• Consolidate the Performance Management cycle data at Europe level – Build & contribute to run all the related HR plans (annual assessment interviews, salary reviews, development plans, training plans)  

• Prepare all appropriate HR documents such as letter, employment contracts and ad hoc correspondences  

• Support the HR Personal administration tasks and lead some of the processes with external partners / providers (payroll coordination, follow up on fringe benefits, individual files,…) and maintain all the HR tracking database (Training plan, work permits, medical checkup, Health Insurance registration, Paid leaves….) 

• Support and run the onboarding process for new comers in the countries  

• Ensure the Processia HR academy regular follow up (eLearning platform) and propose appropriate communication to promote the content 

• Contribute to some HR transversal initiatives and team projects  

The Successful Applicant
 
 

• Job Skills  
 

• At least 3 years of relevant experience in HR in France, UK, Belgium or Netherlands. Ideally familiar with French social legislation 

• Small and fast-paced environment/companies first experience (“PME”) 

• Strong computer skills (Excel and Powerpoint as a must).  

• Fluent French and English, good knowledge of Dutch would be a plus   

·
 Behavioral skills: 
 

- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, ability to build solid relationships with employees, positive open attitude, team spirit.
 

- Autonomy, willingness and ability to work remotely
 

- Flexibility to deal with last minute changes, can-do attitude, problem solver, ability to remain calm under pressure
